en.name: Biltong
en.summary: Biltong is beef or game marinated in vinegar and spice and air-dried without heat. Properly dried, it keeps 2 weeks at room temperature in a sealed container; refrigerated 1–2 months, and frozen about 6 months. A thick, moist, red-centred slice is a perishable meat, not a dried one.
en.pantry: Two weeks at room temperature in a sealed container is the honest ceiling for properly dried biltong, and it is the published figure for properly dried jerky. What keeps dried meat safe is water activity — how much water is actually available to microbes, not how dry it looks — so a thick, moist, red-centred slice cut wet belongs in the fridge from the start. If it is still soft, keep it in paper or a breathable cloth bag rather than sealed plastic: airtight plastic traps moisture against the surface and grows mould within days. There is a safety point worth knowing about home-dried biltong: the standard recommendation for home-dried meat is that the strips reach an internal 160 °F, either by heating in the marinade before drying or by oven-heating afterwards, precisely because air-drying alone may not kill pathogens such as E. coli O157:H7 — and traditional biltong, cured in vinegar and salt and hung to dry cold, includes no such heat step.
en.fridge: Refrigerating or freezing dried meat extends its shelf life and keeps the flavour, and 1–2 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below is a fair working figure, borrowed from what is published for home-made jerky. Sliced biltong dries out and goes dusty in the fridge, so whole sticks hold up much better — slice as you eat. Keep it in a paper bag inside a loosely closed box rather than sealed airtight, unless it is genuinely bone dry.
en.freezer: For anything beyond a month, vacuum-seal it and freeze: about 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F), which is our own figure rather than a published one. Freeze whole sticks rather than slices, and thaw them in the fridge, not on the counter. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about the fat, which is what eventually turns rancid and gives old biltong its stale, tallowy note.
en.thawing: Thaw vacuum-sealed sticks in the fridge and slice them as you eat. Do not thaw biltong at room temperature in a sealed bag — condensation on the surface is what starts mould.
spoilage: Fuzzy white, green or black mould, especially inside a sealed bag.
A damp, tacky or slippery surface on what should be dry.
A sour or fermented smell rather than a vinegar-and-spice one.
A rancid, tallowy smell from the fat, or a dull grey cast.
tips: Keep soft, moist biltong in the fridge from day one.
Store it in paper or cloth, not sealed plastic, unless it is bone dry.
Buy or cut whole sticks and slice as you eat; slices dry out fast.
Home-dried is not the same as a commercial vacuum-packed product — follow the printed date on the latter.

faq.q: How long does biltong keep at room temperature?
faq.a: 2 weeks in a sealed container if it is properly dried. Thick, moist slices are a perishable meat and belong in the fridge.
Refrigerating or freezing extends shelf life and keeps the flavour: 1–2 months at 4 °C or below. Soft, moist biltong needs it from the start.
Yes, about 6 months at −18 °C, vacuum-sealed and in whole sticks. That figure is our own rather than a published one.

faq.q: Is home-made biltong as safe as shop-bought?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Commercial biltong is a controlled-water-activity product with a printed date. The standard advice for home-dried meat is a heat step to 160 °F, which traditional biltong does not include.

zh.name: 南非風乾牛肉
zh.summary: Biltong 是牛肉或野味用醋和香料醃過後、不加熱風乾而成的肉乾。真正乾透的，密封放室溫可放 2 週；冷藏 1～2 個月；冷凍約 6 個月。厚切、中心還帶紅的濕潤肉片，屬於易腐肉品而不是乾貨。
zh.pantry: 「密封容器放室溫 2 週」是乾透的 biltong 誠實的上限，這也是「正確乾燥的肉乾」的公告值。讓乾肉安全的是水活性——也就是微生物真正能利用的水分，而不是它看起來多乾——所以切得厚、中心濕潤帶紅的那種，從一開始就該放冰箱。如果它還偏軟，請用紙袋或透氣布袋裝，不要用密封塑膠袋：密封塑膠會把水氣封在表面，幾天就長霉。關於自家風乾的 biltong，有一個安全重點值得知道：家庭乾燥肉品的標準建議是肉條中心要達到 160 °F，做法是乾燥前先在醃汁中加熱、或乾燥後再進烤箱，原因正是單靠風乾未必能殺死大腸桿菌 O157:H7 之類的病原；而傳統 biltong 用醋和鹽醃過後低溫吊乾，完全沒有這道加熱步驟。
zh.fridge: 冷藏或冷凍可以延長乾肉的保存期並保住風味，4 °C 以下 1～2 個月是合理的工作數字，借自「自製肉乾」的公告值。切片的 biltong 在冰箱裡會乾掉、口感變粉，整條保存好得多——要吃再切。除非它真的乾透了，否則請用紙袋裝再放進不完全密閉的盒子，不要密封。
zh.freezer: 超過一個月的份量請真空封袋冷凍：−18 °C 下約 6 個月，這是我們自己的數字，不是公告值。請整條冷凍而不是切片，解凍時放冷藏、不要放室溫。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是脂肪，那才是最後會油耗、讓舊肉乾出現陳舊油味的部分。
zh.thawing: 真空包的整條請放冷藏解凍，要吃再切。不要把密封袋放在室溫解凍——表面的結露正是長霉的起點。
spoilage: 長出白色、綠色或黑色絨毛霉，密封袋裡尤其常見。
本該乾燥的表面變得潮濕、發黏或滑膩。
聞起來發酸或有發酵味，而不是醋與香料的味道。
脂肪出現油耗、陳舊油脂的氣味，或整體泛暗灰。
tips: 偏軟、偏濕的 biltong 從第一天就放冰箱。
除非乾透，否則用紙或布裝，不要密封塑膠袋。
買或切整條，要吃再切片；切片乾得很快。
自家做的和商業真空包不是同一回事——後者請依包裝標示日期。

faq.q: biltong 放室溫可以放多久？
faq.a: 真正乾透的話，密封容器放室溫 2 週。厚切濕潤的則屬易腐肉品，要放冰箱。
冷藏或冷凍可以延長保存並保住風味：4 °C 以下 1～2 個月。偏軟偏濕的更是從一開始就需要。
可以，真空封袋整條放 −18 °C 約 6 個月。這是我們自己的數字，不是公告值。

faq.q: 自製 biltong 和市售的一樣安全嗎？
faq.a: 不一定。商業產品是水活性受控的製品，並有標示日期。家庭乾燥肉品的標準建議是加熱到 160 °F，而傳統 biltong 沒有這道步驟。
